name: Devin Desktop
desc: Desktop app for running and watching Devin sessions side by side.
desc_zh: 并排运行和观察多个 Devin 会话的桌面应用。
solves: Watching an agent in a browser tab means losing it among other tabs; sessions get their own window with a language server for local code.
solves_zh: 在浏览器标签里看智能体，容易被其他标签挤掉；会话有了自己的窗口，还带本地代码的语言服务。
best_for: You keep three agents going at once and want to see all three without switching tabs.
best_for_zh: 同时开三个智能体任务，想不切标签就看清三边的进展。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cognition.com/blog directory）。 This is the renamed Windsurf editor: the ledger carries Windsurf@2023-11-14 with status renamed. 首次公开日期来源：https://cognition.com/blog/introducing-devin-desktop
